name: Ran
source:
Ran is [url=/c12530]Hatsuyuki's[/url] caretaker and guardian, having taken care of him for as long as he can remember. It is through a certain incident involving Ran that propels Hatsuyuki to complete his mission before spring comes.

[From [url=http://amaenboda.wordpress.com/2012/03/11/hatsuyuki-sakura-review/]Aedes' review[/url]]
